title: Transferrin saturation

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: Transferrin saturation reflects how much of the blood protein transferrin is carrying iron. Transferrin is the protein that moves iron throughout the body, and this measure is part of a group of iron tests.
context: This measure is usually read together with other iron tests to understand iron levels. A result outside the usual range does not always mean a condition that needs care, and some medicines, such as birth control pills and estrogen, along with menstrual cycles, can affect iron levels.
aboveRange: A higher result may be associated with high iron levels in the body, such as iron overload (hemochromatosis)
May be associated with some liver conditions
belowRange: A lower result may be associated with low iron levels in the body, which can be a sign of anemia
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
